jobs.occupation: English-speaking Primary School Teacher (Lehrer/in - Grundschulen)
jobs.description:
For the International Montessori School **in Berlin-Wannsee **we are looking for an

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Ref. Nr. 376DR-BA

Your Employer

Montessori & Friends Education gGmbH is an innovative educational institution that runs several children’s centres, the International Bilingual Montessori Primary School and its own Montessori Academy. These facilities create nurturing learning environments for children based on the educational philosophy of Maria Montessori. At the primary school, 130 children learn in mixed-age groups on the grade-levels 1-6. The historic school building is situated in an idyllic location not far from Lake Wannsee. The opening of a secondary school on the same site is planned for the 2026/27 academic year. The school’s aim is to promote self-directed learning and support the holistic development of the children. Another key focus of the school is bilingual education. Around half of the pupils come from English-speaking or bilingual homes and are taught bilingually from grade 1 in both German and English.

Your Responsibilities

As a teacher, you will guide a maximum of 24 students in mixed-age learning groups (grades 1–3) and provide them with individualized support. You will be actively supported by a co-teacher. You will teach all standard elementary school subjects exclusively in English and work according to the principles of Montessori pedagogy. A trusting partnership with parents is just as important as your own creative freedom.

The school offers you 

- a permanent, full-time position,
- competitive compensation, as well as additional benefits and bonuses,
- Childcare spots for your own children in the school’s own daycare centers and at the school, subject to availability,
- regular professional development opportunities and a chance to gain an internationally recognized Montessori-Diploma,
- a supportive team and a friendly, family-like work environment.

This opportunity is for you if

- you have a teaching qualification recognised in the Federal State of Berlin, such as a Master of Education, a German 2. Staatsexamen für die Grundschule/Sekundarstufe I, a foreign teaching degree, or (N)QTS.
- you have already gained experience teaching English at the primary school level,
- you have a Montessori diploma or practical Montessori experience, and the willingness to earn a Montessori diploma while working at the school,
- you have a minimum of a C1 level in English and a minimum of a B1 level in German,
- you enjoy working in a team and cooperating closely with parents and caregivers.

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and details of your relevant qualifications. Please send your application, quoting reference number 376DR-BA, via email (info@lehrcare.de) in PDF format, to Dorottya Toth, who will be happy to provide you with further information.

jobs.occupation: Junior Information Security Professional (f/m/d) (Informationssicherheitsbeauftragte/r)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Does shaping your career in a modern digital company where information security plays a central role sound exciting to you? Would you like to further optimize our security level for over 42 million customers and thus make an important contribution to global data and information security? Then you've come to the right place! As a Junior Security Professional in our Security Governance & Assurance team, which is responsible for the strategic aspects of information security at Mail & Media, you can grow into the following tasks:

- Designing and optimizing security-critical processes: You will optimize our internal security policies and guidelines as well as the BCM (Business Continuity Management) System, taking into account internal and external compliance requirements, state-of-the-art technical options, and the interests and structure of the company.
- Conducting security audits and assessments: You carry out audits and assessments in our internal departments as well as at business partners and suppliers, prepare the results in a target group-oriented manner, and support the closure of identified gaps.
- Increasing security awareness: You will contribute to a continuous increase in security awareness within the company by preparing and conducting training courses and presentations for various technical and non-technical target groups.
- Projects to improve the safety level: You will work on projects that increase the company's safety level.
- Preparation and representation in external audits: You will prepare necessary documentation and represent Mail & Media in external security audits, such as ISO27001.

Your Profile

Are you interested in information security and do you see yourself as an all-rounder and problem solver? Do you have a high affinity for technology and business? Are you open-minded, sociable, and enjoy working with people? Are you characterized by an analytical and structured way of working? Are you able to present complex problems and contexts in a way that is understandable for different target groups? Then we look forward to receiving your application! The following points will increase your chances:

- Degree and training: You have successfully completed or are about to complete a degree in (business) informatics or in a comparable area. You have specialized in information security and/or gained relevant practical experience, e.g., through internships.
- Technical basics and trends: You have sound theoretical technical knowledge and at the same time follow current trends such as AI, digitization, or DevSecOps. You enjoy gaining practical experience that helps you identify security risks in IT infrastructures and propose economic measures.
- Data affinity: You have a high affinity for data and data-driven decisions. Ideally, you have gained experience in the areas of data analysis, data visualization, data science, or process mining during your studies.
- Team player: You are a team player who leads by example at all times. Your commitment, empathy, and continuous willingness to learn will help you gain the necessary trust in the organization.
- Communication skills: Your ability to communicate verbally and in writing in a manner appropriate to the recipient (in German and English, both at C1+ level) rounds off your profile.

Our Benefits

🏢Lived corporate culture: Flat hierarchies, a culture of respect and appreciation, signatories of the Diversity Charter, open communication, and no dress code

🎓Wide range of further training: Internal and external training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning, language courses, talent development programs, conferences, and mentoring

💡 TEC-Campus: Free choice between Linux, Mac, or Windows, slack days, conferences, lecture series, courses, open-source projects, community meetups, and user groups

❤️ Active health care: Wellpass, free internal sports and fitness classes, health days, family & care support services, discounts at fitness centers, mental health first responder, fresh fruit, and drinks for free

🚝Mobility: Subsidy for job bike leasing, job ticket, and relocation service if you live outside Germany

💻Flexible working models: Home office options, flexible working hours, and 30 days of vacation with the option for additional unpaid leave

💰Financial benefits: Corporate benefits, company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits, occupational disability insurance, and various partner discounts

🎉 Events: Summer and winter parties, sports tournaments, and team events

Umfang: Maximal 40%
